claims: Part 1: binary-level diff of igf5 (25981 B, zero records, correlated crashes) vs igf4 (26077 B, last known-good probe that loaded and produced records) using readelf/objdump/nm on PRX and inner ELFs

Part 2: rebuild igf6 probe with direct read (plain dereference/memcpy) of 16B code anchors at 0x33ac8c0 and 0x890aa0, no mprotect, no syscall, no permission gates; igf4 packaging recipe; two-run determinism
Part 3: STAGE-PLAN + REPORT.md with binary-diff analysis
